notes: A worked example of the gold-set format, runnable with no downloads. Use it as the template for your own paper: write the question, then paste a distinctive phrase from the passage that answers it into `evidence`.

questions.question: What F1 score does GLIDE achieve?
How many patients are in the cohort, and how many readings?
What baselines is the method compared against?
What happens to performance when the population prior is removed?
evidence: Removing the population prior drops F1 to 0.74

questions.question: How was the train/test split constructed?
evidence: split is by patient rather than by reading

questions.question: What is the exponential forgetting factor?
What limitations do the authors acknowledge?
evidence: did not evaluate on paediatric patients

questions.question: What value is the shrinkage parameter set to?
Where does the improvement mostly come from?
evidence: recall on patients with fewer than two hundred

questions.question: What was the p-value of the significance test?
How does GLIDE perform on cardiac pacemaker data?
